# Weller Logs

> A free well-log viewer for quick correlation and zone petrophysics, in the browser. Built by Ryan Weller
> (https://ryweller.com). Your files stay on your machine: everything runs client-side and nothing is uploaded.

## What it does

- Opens LAS 2.0 well logs, tops CSV, point-data CSV and PDF/TIFF mudlogs (drag and drop or Open…).
- Shows single-well log plots and multi-well correlation cross sections, with a map of well locations.
- Picks and edits formation tops; flattens on a top; draws isopach and structure grids.
- Computes screening petrophysics per zone: shale volume, porosity, water saturation, net and pay, curve statistics.
- Curve QC (gaps, spikes, units), a curve editor, saved views, and exports to PNG, LAS, CSV and a project bundle.

## How to use it

Open https://logs.ryweller.com. Example Niobrara wells load on first visit. Load your own LAS files to replace them.
Methods, equations and assumptions: https://logs.ryweller.com/methods.html (Markdown: https://logs.ryweller.com/methods.md)
